issues.title: `inventory total` prints the wrong value
issues.body:
`inventory total` gives the wrong value for some stock files. With this file:

```
D4,washer,10,1.5
```

it prints `$10.50`, but 10 washers at $1.50 are `$15.00`. I think the sum in `total_value` in `inventory/report.py` is wrong.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] For a stock file with the line `D4,washer,10,1.5`, `inventory total` prints `$15.00`.
- [ ] A price with one decimal digit, for example `1.5`, is read as 150 cents.
- [ ] A price with two decimal digits, for example `12.05`, is still read as 1205 cents.
